claim_being_audited: The strongest supportable certification decision on the current record is to certify the model only if the certification packet explicitly discloses the unresolved insurance-claims triage limitation and the draft state of mitigation controls.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if the admissible evidence supports certification on the stated terms and those terms satisfy policy.
Policy requires disclosure of material limitations for named launch use cases unless the issue is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Draft monitoring or future controls do not remove a current disclosure requirement unless approved.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support launch readiness but do not negate the unresolved slice weakness.
evidence_requests: Final model-card text or certification packet showing the limitation disclosure.
Any approved risk-acceptance record, if one exists.
A finalized mitigation/runbook record with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Any formal materiality assessment for the insurance-claims triage weakness.
specific_concerns: The admissible record shows an unresolved below-target issue in a named launch use case, concentrated in catastrophe-claim evidence triage.
The mitigation runbook is still draft-only and lacks a defined alert threshold and accountable owner, so it does not satisfy the policy standard for removing a disclosure requirement.
The current model-card draft says there are no known material limitations, which is in tension with the unresolved slice issue and reviewer comment.
The recommendation is supportable only as a conditional certification-with-disclosure position; the evidence does not support a clean certification without that disclosure.
unsupported_claims: There is no admissible evidence that an approved risk acceptance exists.
There is no admissible evidence that the final certification packet or final model card has already been updated to disclose the limitation.
There is no explicit admissible materiality determination document; materiality is inferred from the unresolved weakness in a named launch use case plus the policy text.
